title: KeePassXC configuration
whyItMatters: KeePassXC keeps its settings and recent-database list here. It shows an offline password manager was used and which database files were opened.
source: KeePassXC User Guide, User Settings Locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/KeePassXC/keepassxc.ini - https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_UserGuide
notes: Configuration only. The .kdbx databases can be stored anywhere and are not searched. Local window state may sit under ~/Library/Caches/KeePassXC. The INI file is never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Make sure every KeePassXC database you need is backed up elsewhere and you know its master password and key file.
steps: Confirm every database is backed up and can be opened.
If you decide to remove the app, move KeePassXC to the Trash from Applications.
Delete the KeePassXC settings folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes KeePassXC settings and the recent-databases list. Database files are not touched, so keep your own backup.
cleanup.source: KeePassXC User Guide, User Settings Locations: https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_UserGuide
